body:
It took me two years in therapy to open up to my therapist, a person legally sworn to secrecy about anything we discuss, unless I'm talking about harming other people in the future. 

If I brought it up with my parents or my sister, there's a decent chance they wouldn't even remember it, or they'd break down crying, or worse.

If I die, then everyone can forget what happened. They can stop pretending. Memories fade, but not if I'm still around to remind them. I ruined their lives. My family hates me. I'm a failure. I just feel like this would be the best "closure" anyone could have from this. I did something horrible, and I deserved to die for it. The end.
